tasks.prompt:
The chart below shows the percentage of journeys to work made by four types of transport in a European city in 2000, 2010 and 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Some people believe that schools should spend more time teaching practical life skills, such as managing money and cooking, even if this means less time for traditional academic subjects.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
